title: Island Jet Ski VT
specs: Spectacular fall foliage views on Lake Whittingham
Minimum age 21 to rent a boat or PWC
Boaters license or safety certificate required if born after 1974
Spotters need to be 14 years of age
Party boats hold 6-8 people max weight 1200lbs
Group rental available on 4 Wave Runners
includes: Fuel and oil included for jet ski rentals
blurb: Guests rent jet skis, pontoons, and ski boats for various durations. Rentals include life vests, fuel, and oil. Guided and unguided sunset tours and fall foliage tours are available.
extraNote: $75 cancellation fee regardless of reason or timing · No cash refunds · All watercraft must be returned clean or $150 cleaning fee applies · All watercraft must be returned with same or equal amount of gasoline or $20 service charge plus $6 per gallon charge applies · Rescue fee minimum $85 for first 30 min, $125 per hour thereafter plus gas charge · Rain is not a reason for cancellation but safety and weather concerns may cause cancellation
